Red is the core because Akshan converts early lane pressure, roaming speed and aggressive takedowns into tempo. Black is also main: Scoundrel marks make resurrection and bonus gold conditional on killing a specific enemy. Blue is off because camouflage, terrain-based movement and target selection can support an information-and-evasion plan, but do not replace his proactive baseline.

Red is main because repeated ability-linked dashes and direct backline access reward initiative, continuous pressure and committed fights. Black is off because her strongest sequences depend on satisfying execution conditions such as correct movement weaving, energy recovery and isolating a target with Public Execution; failed commitment carries a positional cost.
Historical champion-wide reference. Use as an initial classification only; role, build, matchup, patch, and team context still require review.

strategicProfiles.reasoning: AI-assisted interpretation: Blue reflects space control and denial through stun, wall and persistent area damage. strategicProfiles.reasoning: AI-assisted provisional interpretation: Red represents Vi's direct, proactive and commitment-heavy access pattern through Vault Breaker and Cease and Desist. Black is conditional: committing onto a chosen target can create power at the cost of position and requires the draft to supply follow-up or a survivable exit. This profile does not mean every Vi draft must snowball, and it does not establish automatic counters or a win probability.
